newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end up, profit-taking slows rally.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end up, profit-taking slows rally.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed up as retail investors continued to buy select scrips, but profit-taking slowed down a lingering bull-run, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange all-share price index rose 61.06 points or 1.70 percent at 3,648.74. Turnover was 433.4 million taka. Of 100 traded issues, 61 gained, 38 lost and one unchanged.

Brokers, however, ruled out any major correction in the short term as they saw demands were still outweighing supply in the share-hungry market. Shine Pukur Holdings gained 37.47 taka to 412.15 and BD Lamps shed 1,289 to 11,593.
